result.detail: Some items in the microarchitecture verification plan are not delivered here: rr_arbiter.sby, rr_arbiter_n5.sby, and the failure-path testbench rr_arbiter_tb_fail.v. This task's expected outputs are only rtl_source and testbench. Submitting a formal_spec would bring in the formal.run/formal.cover requirements, and two .sby files would be refused as a list. The properties are already in the RTL under ifdef FORMAL, so a follow-up task can add one .sby per N (mode prove, prep -top rr_arbiter, chparam N). The interface spec requires formal proof and an N=5 proof, so that follow-up should be scheduled; the tech lead should confirm it. Testbench check codes: 1 grant != model, 2 not one-hot-or-zero, 3 grant without request, 4 not work conserving, 5 wait > N-1, 6 rotation after reset, 20-26 and 30+r coverage goals. No timescale is used in either file, so Verilator does not see mixed timescales.
